text: There is a massive competitive advantage right now in building 'boring' infrastructure manually instead of rushing to wrap an AI API. text: Atom Computing | Many posititions | Boulder, CO/Austin, TX/Berkeley, CA | Some ONSITE, Some HYBRID We're hiring software engineers, hardware engineers, RF engineers, FPGA and ASIC engineers, Optics/Mechanical/Optomech engineers, and Physicists with a background in atomic physics and/or characterization of quantum systems. We trap Ytterbium atoms with lasers, and then use each atom as a qubit in a quantum register. A flash of green light accomplishes the quantum analog of a NOT gate. Two atoms held sufficiently close followed by a flash of UV light accomplishes the quantum analog of an XOR gate. The company is well funded and growing quickly. We have an endless supply of rich and interesting signal processing challenges. Atoms, famously used in atomic clocks, are very precise and sensitive to all the imperfections in your system. This makes for very demanding signal paths. Compiling programs for this architecture also involves interesting compiler challenges/optimizations. You'll have fun.

text: Prior Labs | Berlin / Freiburg / NYC | ONSITE | Full-time | Multiple Roles | Deep learning transformed text and images but mostly skipped tables - the data behind most clinical trials, financial models, and scientific experiments. The reason is structural: no natural sequence, no spatial structure, no shared vocabulary across datasets, so the architectures and scaling laws behind LLMs don't transfer. Our approach: pre-train a transformer on millions of synthetic datasets sampled from causal-structure priors. Your whole dataset goes in as context, predictions come out in a single forward pass - no per-dataset training, no hyperparameter tuning, seconds instead of hours. It works: TabPFN v2 was published in Nature and set a new state of the art; TabPFN-3 scales to 10M rows. 4M+ downloads, 8k+ GitHub stars, production use from liquid biopsy to rail maintenance. As of last month we're an independent lab inside SAP, backed by €1B+ - models stay open, research stays public, same team and offices.
